queries.title: Stored-property entries by recorded disposition
queries.method: Rows of Stored-property fixture, released are counted by the text in disposition exactly as written; rows where it is blank are counted apart. An entry is counted as released when date_released is not blank. A row is an entry in the log as released, not necessarily one item or one person.
queries.sql:
WITH entries AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("disposition" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS disposition, NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("date_released" AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL AS released, CAST(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(CAST("date_stored" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP), TRY_STRPTIME(CAST("date_stored" AS VARCHAR), ['%m/%d/%Y, %I:%M %p', '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M', '%m/%d/%Y', '%-m/%-d/%Y'])) AS DATE) AS taken
 FROM "analysis_belongings_released"
)
SELECT disposition, COUNT(*) AS entries, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS all_entries, COUNT(*) OVER () AS dispositions,
 SUM(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE released)) OVER () AS released_entries,
 CAST(MIN(MIN(taken)) OVER () AS VARCHAR) AS first_taken, CAST(MAX(MAX(taken)) OVER () AS VARCHAR) AS last_taken
FROM entries GROUP BY disposition ORDER BY entries DESC, disposition LIMIT 8

queries.title: Stored-property entries by recorded disposition
queries.method: Rows of Stored-property fixture, bare are counted by the text in disposition exactly as written; rows where it is blank are counted apart. The table has no release or retrieval date column, so releases are not counted. A row is an entry in the log as released, not necessarily one item or one person.
queries.sql:
WITH entries AS (
 SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(CAST("disposition" AS VARCHAR)), '') AS disposition, CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS released, CAST(COALESCE(TRY_CAST(CAST("date_stored" AS VARCHAR) AS TIMESTAMP), TRY_STRPTIME(CAST("date_stored" AS VARCHAR), ['%m/%d/%Y, %I:%M %p', '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M', '%m/%d/%Y', '%-m/%-d/%Y'])) AS DATE) AS taken
 FROM "analysis_belongings_bare"
)
SELECT disposition, COUNT(*) AS entries, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS all_entries, COUNT(*) OVER () AS dispositions,
 CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS released_entries,
 CAST(MIN(MIN(taken)) OVER () AS VARCHAR) AS first_taken, CAST(MAX(MAX(taken)) OVER () AS VARCHAR) AS last_taken
FROM entries GROUP BY disposition ORDER BY entries DESC, disposition LIMIT 8
